And every skin tone needs sunscreen, whether you're Fitzpatrick 1 or 6. Then we have a gentle cleanser that can be used once or twice daily. The most important job here is getting the whole days worth of gunk off your skin without stripping your barrier. Too harsh of a cleanser can damage the top layer of your skin, which can make acne and sensitivity a lot worse. If you're not sure, go for a non foaming or gentle foaming cleanser so you don't risk over stripping your skin. And finally, a good moisturizer. In literature, moisturizing regularly is the best Established way to maintain and repair your barrier function. They also reduce trans epidermal water loss, which means less water is escaping your skin. That is all essential to keep your skin in a happy state. And can help avoid potential flaring with skin conditions like perioral dermatitis, rosacea, or eczema. A good moisturizer will have three types of ingredients, including humectants, occlusive moisturizers, and emollients. Your skin type doesn't change what you need. It changes the textures of the products you're buying. If you're oily, you go for a foaming cleanser, A lightweight moisturizer, and a liquidy sunscreen.
